description: Generate one or more images using OpenAI's GPT Image models and save outputs to your workspace.

background.description: Background style. 'transparent' produces a cutout with an alpha channel; it requires png or webp output. The default model supports it; gpt-image-2 does not.

count.description: How many images to generate (1-8). Cost multiplies by count.

output_compression.description: Compression level 0-100 (higher = better quality, larger file). Only applies when output_format is jpeg or webp.

output_format.description: Output file format (defaults to png). jpeg and webp produce smaller files; only png and webp support transparency.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

quality.description: Image quality (defaults to high). Medium is usually about 10-20 seconds and $0.01-0.02; high usually takes 20-60 seconds and costs about $0.05-0.08.

name: generate_image
title: Generate Image
